doc: Improved Perlin noise, float32, at 2000 random points in [-8, 8]^3 (cells of both signs), seed 6 (the permutation is the input plan0.perm). The 8 corner hashes of the points reach all 16 gradient branches (checked at build time). Output float32, |value| < 0.8. Chained float32 (about 30 operations): measured against the float64 evaluation of the same inputs 1.2e-6 at most, against a float32 evaluation with another operation order (a*(1-t)+b*t) 1.9e-7; tolerance 1.5e-5 abs + 1e-5 rel (10x). The permutation input plan<i>.perm is the draw as recorded (256 entries for Perlin3, 1024 for Worley3); the kernel indexes it DOUBLED, concat(perm, perm) (512 or 2048 entries, so p[i + 256] = p[i]): a port that indexes the stored array directly runs off its end (see the .table cases).
